text:
alex: quick heads-up — starting v2 canary for mobile route: shift 10% -> 30% over 45m. preflight checks passed. watching latency + error counters. release notes: https://redwood.app/releases/v2  @maria @sam

deploy-bot: Deploy started for service=api-gateway route=mobile canary_percent=10 id=dep-3098765432

maria: seeing a small uptick in `edge-client` 502s from mobile users, +0.9%  in last 6m. looks concentrated in eu-west. :eyes:

sam: can you paste a sample trace / request-id? also what header variations are failing?

maria: sample log:
```
req_id=89a1f service=api-gateway route=/v2/client method=POST status=502 error="upstream reset" hdrs="Authorization,X-Client-Version,x-client-id"
```

irene: hmm that header set looks fine. however mobile SDK 1.3.0 flips `x-client-version` casing for some requests. we flagged that in SDK notes but didn't block. @dawn any quick channel to mobile sdk folks?

dawn: pinged mobile-sdk in #mobile-dev. they replied — a small release rolled yesterday with a header-name normalization change. will revert if needed.

sam: two options: 1) pause the canary and pin mobile route back to v1 for affected SDK versions, or 2) continue but add header-case tolerant shim at the gateway. shim could be fast but needs a small deploy.

maria: current error rate causes ~1.2% of requests to fail for EU mobile. user impact is small but nontrivial. I'd prefer pause+pin while we hotfix.

alex: i agree with pause+pin for mobile clients. we don't want customer-facing errors while canary expands. deploy-bot, pause rollout and pin mobile clients to v1 for SDK versions <=1.3.0

deploy-bot: Automatic action: pausing canary id=dep-3098765432. Current canary_percent=10 -> HOLD. Applying route pin: route=mobile pinned_version=v1 for client_sdk_versions=<=1.3.0. Fallback enabled.

dawn: noted. opening a hotfix ticket: RH-9123 "mobile sdk header casing -> gateway tolerance". assigning to mobile-sdk + eng-runtime. ETA preliminary patch: 2-3 hours.

irene: in parallel i'll add a temporary gateway header normalization rule (simple lowercase mapping) and test in staging. if it's safe we can revert pin and resume canary once mobile SDK publishes patch.

sam: also update release notes and the weekly changelog — callout that mobile SDK 1.3.0 users were pinned to v1 and that a patch will be rolled into the next SDK release.

alex: excellent. can we also capture telemetry window for rollback criteria? propose: if error rate stays >0.5% for 30m after patch, keep pin. otherwise, resume. anyone object?

maria: sounds reasonable. keeping an eye on latency too.

dawn: added owners and notes to RH-9123. I'll post a short update in #customer-impact and tag success.

alex: thanks all — timeline summary: pause canary (done), pin mobile clients <=1.3.0 to v1 (done), hotfix ticket RH-9123 opened, gateway shim test in staging (irene), resume criteria agreed. I'll follow up with a short PR to release-notes and a rollback playbook snippet. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Event: canary pause confirmed for dep-3098765432 at 2026-03-20T10:26:03Z

maria: leaving monitoring alert pinned. will post if anything changes.

alex: if mobile-sdk team pushes a patch, we will validate in canary (10%) for 30m then ramp. otherwise maintain pin until next SDK release. thanks everyone.
